scope: NSCLC predictive biomarkers (driver alterations + immunotherapy markers). The actionable panel is the densest of the six cancers and moves fast. Internal substrate only.
panel_note: Comprehensive molecular profiling in advanced non-squamous NSCLC minimally covers: EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, KRAS, METex14, RET, NTRK, ERBB2/HER2, plus PD-L1. 2025 added MET-protein IHC and TROP-2 as selection markers for ADCs. Verify every therapy linkage at write time — this list changes quarterly.

biomarker_records.scoring: Activating mutation type matters: exon 19 deletion / L858R (classic sensitizing); exon 20 insertion (distinct agents); T790M (resistance); atypical (S768I, L861Q, G719X).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Sensitizing mutations gate EGFR TKIs (incl. osimertinib); exon 20 insertions gate distinct agents; adjuvant and stage III (post-chemoRT) indications exist for EGFR disease.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: EGFR TKI trials / FDA companion dx

biomarker_records.scoring: Fusion present vs absent; IHC is a sensitive screen with molecular confirmation.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Gates ALK TKIs; adjuvant indication exists in early-stage ALK+ disease.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: ALK TKI trials / FDA companion dx

biomarker_records.scoring: Fusion present vs absent; IHC screen confirmed molecularly.

biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: V600E gates BRAF + MEK inhibitor combination; first-line option.

biomarker_records.scoring: Specific G12C variant required (other KRAS variants not targeted by current G12C agents).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: G12C gates KRAS G12C inhibitors (sotorasib 2021, adagrasib 2022) as second-line after prior systemic therapy.

biomarker_records.scoring: c-MET overexpression by IHC (distinct from METex14 and MET amplification).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: 2025: gates the MET-directed ADC telisotuzumab vedotin (accelerated approval, May 2025) in previously treated NSCLC. Adds an IHC arm to the MET diagnostic algorithm alongside NGS/FISH.
Gates HER2-directed ADC therapy (trastuzumab deruxtecan) in HER2-mutant NSCLC.
Gates and stratifies immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy (monotherapy favored at high TPS); relevant across histologies including squamous.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: Checkpoint inhibitor trials / FDA companion dx

biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: 2025: TROP-2-directed ADC (datopotamab deruxtecan) approved for metastatic EGFR-mutated NSCLC after prior EGFR-targeted therapy. Selection biology still maturing.

notes: Histology gates the panel: full driver profiling concentrates in adenocarcinoma/non-squamous. 2025 expanded the diagnostic algorithm with MET-protein IHC and TROP-2 for ADC selection — a Digital/Liquid Pulse crossover. ctDNA is an accepted complementary specimen across most of these. Re-verify the actionable list at every write.
